notes.unstable_angina: Map to NA for type_acs: it is an acute coronary syndrome distinct from NSTEMI; the case enum has no UA value.
notes.ecg_avb: Case-first binary interpretation overrides expert ordinal interpretation.
notes.ecg_elevation: Case binary missing rule overrides expert preference for not specified on no mention.
notes.strings: Expert CSV examples sometimes show JSON numbers, but submission values remain strings because the case contract explicitly requires string values.

unresolved_but_configured.combined_mi_localisation: Use medical-expert/engineering mapping only when case has no explicit combination rule.
unresolved_but_configured.multiple_echo_or_xray: Prefer first relevant study unless a field-specific selection policy says otherwise.
unresolved_but_configured.therapy: Prefer discharge/recommendation section over transient inpatient therapy when available.
unresolved_but_configured.cag_not_done_non_refusal: Map to N because case exposes only Y/R/N.
